title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)

Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.” Show: A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON. Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders. Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently. (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”. Deliverables A GitHub repository with the app source code.
